items.question: What material are the head towels made from?
items.answer: Our Luxury Head Towels are made from premium 100% Egyptian Cotton — one of the finest, most absorbent cotton varieties in the world, renowned for its softness, durability, and comfort.

items.question: How do I use a head towel?
items.answer: Simply place the towel over your head after washing, tuck or wrap the loop/button to secure it in place, and allow your hair to dry naturally. The hands-free design means you can continue your routine while your hair dries.

items.question: How do I wash and care for my Luxury Head Towel?
items.answer: Machine wash at 40°C with similar colours. Tumble dry on a low setting or air dry naturally. Avoid bleach and fabric softeners to maintain the cotton's natural absorbency and softness.

items.question: Is it suitable for all hair types?
items.answer: Yes. Our one-size-fits-all head towel is designed to suit all hair types and lengths — fine, thick, curly, straight, short, or long. It works equally well for women and children.

items.question: What size is the head towel?
items.answer: Our head towels are designed as one size fits all, offering a comfortable and secure fit for the vast majority of head sizes. The wrap design adjusts naturally to suit you.

items.question: Where are the head towels manufactured?
items.answer: Our Luxury Head Towels are proudly made in the United Kingdom. We are committed to supporting British craftsmanship and ensuring the highest standards of quality.

items.question: What colours are available?
items.answer: We currently offer four elegant colour options: White with Blue Trim, Blue with White Trim, Salmon Pink, and Grey. All reflect the premium aesthetic of the Luxury Head Towels brand.

items.question: Are these suitable as gifts?
items.answer: Absolutely. Our Luxury Head Towels make a thoughtful, premium gift for birthdays, Mother's Day, pamper hampers, or any occasion. Please contact us for gift or bulk enquiries.
